content: Excited to share that our Tier-1 Retail customer just shipped their multi-agent product catalog analyzer to production! Delivered their first agent MVP in 5 days using ADK and Gemini 2.0 Flash.

Heads up team: we hit a 429 rate limit / quota exceeded error on Vertex AI during peak customer load testing for the fintech POC. Has anyone else encountered TPM limits on gemini-2.0-flash in us-central1?

For anyone working with BigQuery vector search and RAG grounding: make sure to enable batch vector embeddings before tool dispatch. It reduced our grounding latency by 40% for the healthcare provider pilot.

P0 alert: Customer bank security team blocked egress due to VPC-SC service perimeter boundary rules. If you are deploying agents inside customer perimeters, ping SecOps for the standardized bridge terraform template.
Great milestone: The supply chain optimization agent pilot was officially approved for full enterprise rollout! Customer leadership loved the sub-agent handoff pattern and deterministic tool calling.
Model Armor and guardrails are working seamlessly with ADK. We integrated input sanitization and prompt injection filters before invoking external MCP connectors.
